run_tandem_dqn_training: run the tandem DQN training loop on an Atari environment like Pong using JAX and GPU
create_optimizer: create an RMSProp or Adam optimizer with fixed learning rates using optax for DQN training
build_atari_environment: build an Atari gym environment wrapped with random noops for training a DQN agent
run_training_iteration: run a single iteration of training or evaluation for a given number of frames
summarize_eval_stats: summarize evaluation statistics including episode return and human normalized score for active or passive agents
